name: One Looking in Cavarzere 2022
information:
## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY**
Please check the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OneLookinginCavarzere2022#17921-covid-19) to understand the safety rules enforced at this competition.
**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OneLookinginCavarzere2022#17920-registration-registrazione).**

## **MASCHERINE FFP2 OBBLIGATORIE**
Consulta la [sezione COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OneLookinginCavarzere2022#17921-covid-19) per comprendere le norme di sicurezza della competizione.
